name: stonebot-artificial-stone-layout
description: Conversational DXF review and nesting through the deterministic Stonebot workflow, with explicit human confirmation gates.

interface.shortDescription: Audit DXF drawings and iterate nesting by conversation
interface.longDescription: Stonebot reads local DXF drawings, audits recognized panels and holes, applies structured corrections, nests confirmed parts on manufacturing sheets and validates the result. Final delivery contains only an in-place DXF and a nested DXF in a folder selected by the user. Word reports are generated only on explicit request.
defaultPrompt: 审计这张 DXF 图纸并告诉我需要确认的问题
用桥切机为这张图排板，先报告板数和出材率
检查当前排板方案并告诉我还能如何优化
